title: TypeSomething chat demo
description: A chat transcript inside a white app window on paper-grey, with a three-dot title bar (the first dot acid). The assistant's ink bubbles sit on the right, the user's blush bubbles on the left, each beside a round avatar with a white ring. Messages rise 12px and fade in as they scroll into view.
notes: avatars are slots (assistantAvatar, userAvatar); empty ones are grey discs
assistant bubbles use the foreground colour as their fill, so they invert under a dark theme
the reveal is a CSS view timeline; without support every message simply shows
